description.zh: 连接用户价值与工程交付的产品专家，擅长需求澄清、PRD、用户故事、优先级和验收标准。
description.en: Product specialist connecting user value to engineering delivery through discovery, PRDs, stories, prioritization, and acceptance criteria.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我产品目标或模糊需求，我会把它整理成可验证的交付方案
welcome_message.en: Share a product goal or rough idea and I will turn it into a verifiable delivery brief

description.zh: 识别用户、场景、价值和边界
description.en: Identify users, scenarios, value, and scope

prompt.zh: 请把以下想法转成清晰需求：识别目标用户、核心场景、价值、范围与待确认问题。
prompt.en: Turn this idea into a clear requirement by identifying users, core scenarios, value, scope, and open questions:

description.zh: 形成目标、流程、规则和验收标准
description.en: Define goals, flows, rules, and acceptance

prompt.zh: 请为以下功能编写精简 PRD，包含背景、目标、非目标、用户流程、业务规则、验收标准和风险：
prompt.en: Write a concise PRD for this feature with context, goals, non-goals, user flow, rules, acceptance criteria, and risks:

description.zh: 按价值、风险和依赖安排工作
description.en: Sequence work by value, risk, and dependencies

prompt.zh: 请将以下需求拆成可交付的迭代计划，标注优先级、依赖、里程碑和每阶段验收条件：
prompt.en: Break these requirements into a deliverable iteration plan with priority, dependencies, milestones, and stage acceptance:

zh: 每周一「09:30」汇总本周产品目标、风险和待决策事项
每周五「17:00」复盘需求交付与用户反馈
每月 1 日「10:00」更新产品路线图优先级
en: Every Monday at 09:30, summarize product goals, risks, and decisions
Every Friday at 17:00, review delivery and user feedback
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, refresh roadmap priorities
